title: Report: Commanders have interest in signing Brandon Aiyuk if 49ers release him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Commanders have interest in signing Brandon Aiyuk if 49ers release him
sources.description: 49ers General Manager John Lynch said before the draft that he's had discussions with teams about a potential trade involving wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk and that he believes there's "a chance" that a deal comes together.
